newsitem.title: SPAIN: NYSE chairman Grasso says "bullish" on Spain.
newsitem.headline: NYSE chairman Grasso says "bullish" on Spain.

text.p: Prospects for Spain are "bullish" based on economic fundamentals, Richard Grasso, chairman of the New York Stock Exchange, told a news conference on Monday.

"(Spain's) economy is now growing, inflation is under check, interest rates are now considerably down from just a short time ago, all these are fundamentals that are very positive to stimulate investment in Spanish securities," Grasso told journalists during a visit to the Madrid stock exchange.

He added that Spain's strategic partnerships within the European Union and with Latin America were also favourable, adding "you could conclude from this that I'm bullish on Spain...and that conclusion would be correct".

Asked to expand on which Spanish companies could reasonably be expected to be listed in New York, he said: "We can verify 50 candidates over the next five years...who would want to use the U.S. as a secondary (equity) source with the primary market here in Madrid."
